mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity SET customer_id = #{record.customerId}, customer_name = #{record.customerName}, opportunity_name = #{record.opportunityName}, source = #{record.source}, expected_amount = #{record.expectedAmount}, win_rate = #{record.winRate}, expected_sign_date = #{record.expectedSignDate}, owner_id = #{record.ownerId}, owner_name = #{record.ownerName}, dept_id = #{record.deptId}, dept_name = #{record.deptName}, contact_id = #{record.contactId}, contact_name = #{record.contactName}, campaign_id = #{record.campaignId}, competitor_id = #{record.competitorId}, remark = #{record.remark}, stage = #{record.stage}, last_stage = #{record.lastStage}, stage_changed_time = #{record.stageChangedTime}, stage_duration_days = #{record.stageDurationDays}, weighted_amount = #{record.weightedAmount}, status = #{record.status}, lost_reason = #{record.lostReason}, team_version = #{record.teamVersion}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} WHERE opportunity_id = #{record.opportunityId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE crm_opportunity SET team_version = #{record.teamVersion} WHERE opportunity_id = #{record.opportunityId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND version = #{record.version} AND team_version = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_opportunity WHERE opportunity_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT opportunity.*, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_opportunity opportunity JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.opportunity_id = #{id} AND opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.opportunity_id, t.tenant_id, t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.opportunity_name, t.stage, t.source, t.expected_amount, t.win_rate, t.last_stage, t.weighted_amount, t.stage_duration_days, t.team_version, t.expected_sign_date, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.dept_id, t.dept_name, t.contact_id, t.contact_name, t.latest_follow_up_time, t.stage_changed_time, t.lost_reason, t.remark, t.status, t.campaign_id, t.competitor_id, t.version, t.deleted, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, c.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, c.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_opportunity t INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.deleted = '0' WHERE t.opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} AND t.deleted = '0'
